score_bandit_experiment: score a bandit experiment by computing the average regret from a pandas DataFrame
plot_learning_curve: plot the average regret learning curve over time for a bandit experiment DataFrame
format_bandit_plot: add bandit-specific formatting with y-axis scales and baseline regret line to a ggplot
plot_individual_seeds: plot individual run returns over time for a bandit experiment colored by seed
review_bandit_analysis: review the bandit analysis module containing score, plot_learning, bandit_learning_format, and plot_seeds functions
